title: Portfolio projects
description: Cards shown on projects.html, in this order.

slots.description: Dashed placeholders shown after the projects (only when no tag filter is active). Remove once the content exists.

hint.description: One line saying what belongs there.

kind.description: Label above the title, e.g. "Work · Deutsche Telekom IT" or "Side project".

summary.description: Problem → what you did, two sentences max. Work projects: role and outcome only.

tags.description: Tools; also used for the filter chips.

repository.description: Source repository URL. github.com and gitlab.com are detected automatically.

repositoryHost.description: Only needed for self-hosted instances, e.g. gitlab.example.com.

caseStudyUrl.description: Write-up link. Without any link the card says "Case study soon".

image.description: Screenshot path relative to public/, e.g. "projects/portfolio.png". Side projects only.
